# Volume 3 timeline

## Chapter I The Shadow of Change

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) chat about growing up and the upcoming changes before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to college. Later, while walking home from the post office, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) runs into [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who tries to express his romantic feelings, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) abruptly cuts the moment short. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) before going off to dream by the brook.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 ch.Change P20](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0020), [v3 ch.Change P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v3 ch.Change P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)_

## Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — The A.V.I.S. throws a farewell party for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave for college, though Anne's evening is somewhat ruined by Gilbert's sentimentality and Charlie Sloane's dull company. The next day, after dealing with discouraging goodbyes from local women, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a peaceful evening walk in the woods with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), restoring her spirits.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P38](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0038)_

## Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a rainy morning after tearful goodbyes and travels by train and boat to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie. Upon arriving, she is warmly greeted by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who whisks her away to their new boardinghouse and helps lift her homesick spirits.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Farewell P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024)_

## Chapter IV April’s Lady

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — After registering at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and feeling overwhelmed and insignificant, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) go to Old St. John's Cemetery in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). There they meet [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), a fellow freshman who introduces herself, and the three girls quickly bond over their shared experiences and fresh beginnings.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Lady P42](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0042)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats freely with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her undecided romantic life, her suitors [Alec](../character/alec.md) and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), and her reasons for attending [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Before parting, the girls inspect an old gravestone, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to lay flowers on the grave of a young sailor. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) reflect on Phil's character.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Lady P67](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0067), [v3 ch.Lady P69](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0069)_

## Chapter V Letters from Home

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as the Freshmen win the annual rush led by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) into her social circle, where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) confides her admiration for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a batch of letters from home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), including updates from Mrs. Lynde, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and Ruby, which reconnects her to her old life.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)_

## Chapter VI In the Park

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Philippa, [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for an autumn walk in the park and enjoy the sunset from a pavilion. On their way back along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), they admire a quaint little house called Patty's Place, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels a strong connection to.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P24](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0024), [v3 ch.Park P30](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0030), [v3 ch.Park P34](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0034)_

## Chapter VII Home Again

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays. Upon her arrival, she receives a enthusiastic welcome from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Lynde, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), who builds a bonfire for her. Before bed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) work through his guilt over wanting to use a bad word he heard from a hired boy.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P18](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0018), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034)_

## Chapter VIII Anne’s First Proposal

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)** — [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) proposes to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) on behalf of her shy brother, [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md). Shocked and amused by the unromantic nature of a proposal by proxy, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses the offer, prompting [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) to respond coldly.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 ch.Proposal P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018), [v3 ch.Proposal P28](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0028)_

## Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — During her term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deals with an unwelcome proposal from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). Later, [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receive a letter from [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) suggesting they rent a house together next year with Stella's aunt as housekeeper. After a long, unsuccessful house hunt, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) discover that Patty's Place is available to let.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002), [v3 ch.Friend P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Friend P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029)_

## Chapter X Patty’s Place

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md), [Patty](../character/patty.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and convince Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) to rent them the home while the two ladies travel to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). After touring the cottage, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) return home, where [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) eagerly begs and gains permission to join their housekeeping arrangement for the upcoming school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

## Chapter XI The Round of Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to visit [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), stopping first at the Wright home where [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) treats them with her sharp, unpleasant tongue. Along the way, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her secret desire to write and publish a short story. When they reach Ruby's home, they find her acting aggressively cheerful and denying her terminal illness while showing off her summer clothes.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042), [v3 ch.Life P52](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0052), [v3 ch.Life P57](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0057)_

## Chapter XII “Averil’s Atonement”

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a short story titled 'Averil's Atonement' and seeks feedback from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), both of whom offer varying criticisms. After submitting it to two separate publishers, the story is rejected by both, leading a discouraged [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to abandon her literary ambitions.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Atonement” P28](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0028), [v3 ch.Atonement” P39](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0039), [v3 ch.Atonement” P60](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0060), [v3 ch.Atonement” P67](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0067)_

## Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors

**[Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Tommy](../character/tommy.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md)** — Rebellious against Mrs. Lynde's rules, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) coerces [Dora](../character/dora.md) into skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing and playing with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons). Afterwards, he lies to Mrs. Lynde to cover up his behavior, but he is tormented by guilt until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home that night and listens to his confession.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), [v3 ch.Transgressors P56](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0056), [v3 ch.Transgressors P93](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0093)_

## Chapter XIV The Summons

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends an evening with a dying [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully confesses her fear of death and her unfulfilled dreams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offers quiet comfort, and Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep the following night. After the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects deeply on life and mortality while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Summons P0](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0000), [v3 ch.Summons P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 ch.Summons P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 ch.Summons P35](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0035)_

## Chapter XV A Dream Turned Upside Down

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) surprises [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by revealing she submitted Anne's story to a baking powder company's contest with added advertisement lines, and that it won the twenty-five dollar prize. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels deeply humiliated and disgraced by the ad placement, though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to comfort her with a practical perspective on the accomplishment.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Down P11](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0011), [v3 ch.Down P15](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0015), [v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022), [v3 ch.Down P35](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0035)_

## Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Patty](../character/patty.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place, furnishing the house and adopting a persistent stray cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) after a failed attempt to chloroform him. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to live with them, bringing along her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) explains her easygoing view on chaperoning the girls at Patty's Place. She brings her two cats, the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), who undergo an adjustment period with the resident cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md). After initial turf wars and squabbles, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) accepts the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat's dominance and eventually becomes close friends with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)_

## Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) arrives with butter and chats with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about rising prices and simple living. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then reads aloud an entertaining letter from [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), which recounts humorously misspelled updates about his school, household misadventures, and curious questions.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Davy P0](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0000), [v3 ch.Davy P5](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0005), [v3 ch.Davy P6](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0006), [v3 ch.Davy P21](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0021)_

## Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a snowbound [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday and finds Gilbert's visits increasingly uncomfortable. She worries about being able to afford her next year at college until she receives a letter announcing a thousand-dollar legacy from the late Miss Josephine Barry.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Anne-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P21](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0021), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P30](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0030)_

## Chapter XIX An Interlude

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) on turning twenty and the development of her character. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) joins them before leaving for a dance, chatting playfully about her appearance, suitors, and future marriage prospects.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 ch.Interlude P3](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0003), [v3 ch.Interlude P7](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0007), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024)_

## Chapter XX Gilbert Speaks

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) chat at Patty's Place about summer plans and their housemates. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) then finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alone in the orchard and confesses his love, asking her to marry him. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects his proposal, leaving them both devastated, and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) later scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for refusing him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P15](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0015), [v3 ch.Speaks P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 ch.Speaks P34](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0034), [v3 ch.Speaks P48](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0048)_

## Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md)** — During a pleasant fortnight visiting [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her humble birthplace where the current occupant allows her to explore the house and gives her a packet of her mother's old letters. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her parents' grave before returning to read the letters, which make her feel truly connected to them for the first time.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P11](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

## Chapter XXII Spring and Anne Return to Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sits reminiscing by the fire at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives home early from college, surprising her warmly. They chat about Anne's walk and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) bursts in, excitedly telling [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about his missing tooth and his thoughts on marriage.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gables P0](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0000), [v3 ch.Gables P4](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0004), [v3 ch.Gables P5](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0005), [v3 ch.Gables P17](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0017)_

## Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md), [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) filled with visits from friends like [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), though she misses [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and deals with questions about their altered relationship. During a stay at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on growing up and admits to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) that she refused Gilbert's desire for something beyond friendship.

_Sources: [v3 ch.People P0](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0000), [v3 ch.People P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 ch.People P19](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0019), [v3 ch.People P26](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0026)_

## Chapter XXIV Enter Jonas

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), Columbia, [Cousin Emily](../character/cousin-emily.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Jonas](../character/jonas.md), [Lilly](../character/lilly.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), Redmond College, [Uncle Mark](../character/uncle-mark.md)** — [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) writes a letter to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounting her summer stay at a boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). She describes the quirky fellow boarders and her growing, albeit conflicted, affection for [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), an earnest theological student preaching there.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_

## Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves Patty's Place to walk in the park on a rainy November afternoon. When her umbrella breaks in the storm, she is rescued by Royal Gardner, a handsome student who perfectly matches her ideal hero. After returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a delivery of roses from [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), sparking talk of romance among her housemates.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P29](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0029), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 ch.Charming P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042)_

## Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md)** — While dressing for a [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) college reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) mentions to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been seeing [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). The news secretly unsettled [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), though she left for the reception with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) and observed [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) with Christine across the room.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

## Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — While preparing for April exams at Patty's Place, the girls learn they can keep the house for another year. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on an evening walk in the park, where she reveals that [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) has proposed to her and she accepted. They discuss Phil's future as a minister's wife, and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) turns the conversation to Anne's feelings for [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 ch.Confidences P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035)_

## Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a June evening. After cheering up [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) regarding his schoolwork, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) listens to Mrs. Rachel talk about Aunt Atossa's funeral and Diana's upcoming wedding. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later wanders down to the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), reflecting mournfully on growing up, losing Diana's close companionship, and her strained dynamic with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Evening P0](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0000), [v3 ch.Evening P9](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0009), [v3 ch.Evening P13](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0013), [v3 ch.Evening P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022)_

## Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Esther](../character/esther.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding, reminiscing about their childhood vows of friendship and future plans. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives to walk [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into the parlor for the ceremony and then accompanies her back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) afterwards, taking a moonlight stroll through Lovers' Lane.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), [v3 ch.Wedding P4](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0004), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013)_

## Chapter XXX Mrs. Skinner’s Romance

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station and is met by Mrs. Amelia [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), who gives her a ride to her boarding house, [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside). During the drive, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) garrulously shares stories about her courtship with her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), her decision to marry for love over money, and her cousin [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) Ann's unhappy marriage.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)_

## Chapter XXXI Anne to Philippa

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) describing her new boarding place at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) and her pleasant landlady, Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet. She describes her cozy room, the quirky parlour, and an awkward visit from a local boy named [Sam](../character/sam.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also hints at an elderly love affair happening nearby that she is observing from afar.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008), [v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009)_

## Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Douglas

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accompanies [Janet](../character/janet.md) to a prayer meeting in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), where she meets [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), Janet's quiet admirer. The next day, John invites them both to his house for tea so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can meet his elderly mother. During the visit, Mrs. Douglas treats [Janet](../character/janet.md) politely while making light comments about her impending death and John's eventual marriage, leaving John looking visibly tortured.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P10](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0010), [v3 ch.Douglas P29](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0029)_

## Chapter XXXIII “He Just Kept Coming and Coming”

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md)** — [Janet](../character/janet.md) tearfully confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) has been visiting her for twenty years without proposing. Encouraged by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to take a firm stand, [Janet](../character/janet.md) sharply rejects John's escort after prayer-meeting, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) immediately regrets her advice upon seeing John's heartbreak and rushes to reconcile them.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Coming” P4](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0004), [v3 ch.Coming” P17](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0017), [v3 ch.Coming” P23](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0023), [v3 ch.Coming” P27](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0027)_

## Chapter XXXIV John Douglas Speaks at Last

**[Alec](../character/alec.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md)** — During her time in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives an awkward proposal from [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she politely rejects and later laughs about with [Janet](../character/janet.md). After John Douglas's mother passes away, [Alec](../character/alec.md) fetches [Janet](../character/janet.md), and John soon arrives to propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md), explaining that his mother forced him to promise to wait until her death before marrying or telling anyone.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P26](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0026), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)_

## Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — The girls return to Patty's Place and chat with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) about Phil's engagement and Aunt Jamesina's old suitors. Later, during a rainy evening of intense studying at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cheer themselves up by reading through dramatic stories written during their childhood [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) days.

## Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher has accepted one of her story sketches, which she happily celebrates with her housemates at Patty's Place. During a walking party with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns that his family intends to visit her. The Gardner family arrives a day earlier than expected on Friday, leading to a frantic scramble and an awkward yet memorable call.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_

## Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends reflect on what they have learned at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as examinations end and graduation arrives. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's lilies instead of Roy's flowers, but she breaks Gilbert's necklace after hearing a rumor about his upcoming engagement. She acts blithely through the graduation dance, refusing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) a dance, and later unwinds with her roommates and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) at Patty's Place.

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P39](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0039)_

## Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — As the girls pack to leave Patty's Place after graduation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a walk with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) proposes to her in romantic fashion, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suddenly realizes she does not love him and refuses his proposal. She returns home shaken and confesses the rejection to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), who eventually forgives and comforts her.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Dawn P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 ch.Dawn P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 ch.Dawn P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 ch.Dawn P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035)_

## Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Inglis](../character/inglis.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disillusioned after rejecting [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), but learns from [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) that he recovers quickly from heartbreak. She hears [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde, clashes with Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) over Jane's lavish engagement, and attends Phil's wedding in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). Back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her newborn baby, feeling increasingly lonely as her friends move on into new stages of life.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Weddings P0](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0000), [v3 ch.Weddings P7](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0007), [v3 ch.Weddings P28](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0028), [v3 ch.Weddings P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041)_

## Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is shocked to hear from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. She spends a grief-stricken night realizing her true feelings for him. In the morning, [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote passes by and informs her that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025), [v3 ch.Revelation P27](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0027)_

## Chapter XLI Love Takes Up the Glass of Time

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to invite her on a walk, which they postpone until the following day. When they walk to Hester Gray's garden, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) confesses his enduring love for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and asks her to marry him. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gladly accepts, and they clear up past misunderstandings before walking home together engaged.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Time P0](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0000), [v3 ch.Time P15](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0015), [v3 ch.Time P22](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0022), [v3 ch.Time P25](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0025)_
